concept:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single isolated tropical shrub concept for an isometric tropical survival videogame.
Primary request: draw one original compact broadleaf tropical shrub, approximately waist-high, rounded but asymmetric, wide at the base and with three taller leaf shoots. Modern hand-painted comic-book game art, graphic dark ink contours, angular cel-shaded color shapes and a few crisp brush marks. Match the tropical illustrated family: lively yellow-green sunlit leaves, olive-green midtones, deep cool green shadow planes, warm brown stems. It should feel like a polished hand-painted 3D game prop with a modern sprite-art finish, not pixel art and not photorealistic.
Subject: overlapping broad lance-shaped leaves with central pale veins, a few small natural tears and holes, readable pointed silhouettes, 3 clustered woody stems visible near the base; enough negative spaces between leaves to let sunlight through. No palm tree or trunk, no coconuts, no flowers.
Composition/framing: exactly one complete shrub, hero three-quarter view seen slightly from above, centered, whole silhouette visible, generous transparent margin. Show leaf layering clearly. No ground patch, no sand, no rocks, no stand, no cast shadow, no presentation board.
Lighting: stylized warm tropical daylight, restrained highlights, no glossy plastic.
Constraints: transparent background with real alpha; no labels, no typography, no logo, no watermark, no border. This is the design concept, not a texture map.
albedo:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square RGBA albedo texture atlas for a broadleaf tropical shrub in an isometric comic-book survival videogame.
Primary request: create a production-oriented flat leaf texture atlas in exactly a 2 by 2 grid with NO visible grid lines. Four isolated individual tropical leaves, one per quadrant; every leaf tip points straight up, every short petiole points straight down, and every leaf is fully visible with at least 10 percent empty margin inside its own quadrant. All four leaves are viewed straight-on from directly above their surface, orthographic, without perspective. Nothing overlaps another quadrant.
Top-left: a broad long lanceolate lime/olive green leaf, pointed tip, centered pale green vein, gently asymmetric lobes.
Top-right: a slightly wider pointed olive-green leaf with two small natural holes and a couple of edge tears, expressive silhouette.
Bottom-left: a narrower darker green leaf, pointed tip, branching painted veins and folded surface shapes.
Bottom-right: a broader yellow-green leaf with a curved asymmetric outline and one small natural hole.
Style/medium: modern hand-painted comic game art matching illustrated tropical survival foliage, crisp dark green-black ink around the silhouette and veins, angular painted color planes, a few deliberate brush marks, no micro photographic grain. Keep midtones rich olive and lime, undersides/pockets cool dark green, warm pale green veins. Consistent neutral diffuse color across all four leaves, no directional light baked into this albedo and no environmental shadows or ambient background shading.
Constraints: genuine transparent background, transparent holes, generous empty transparent gutters, no shadows, no ground, no rocks, no stems beyond short petioles, no shrub render, no material sphere, no text, no labels, no frames, no watermark. Four flat individual leaf cutouts only. Output a square texture, ideally 1024 by 1024.
normal:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: tangent-space OpenGL normal texture for the supplied RGBA 2 by 2 tropical leaf albedo atlas.
Primary request: transform Image 1 into its matching technical normal map. Image 1 is the exact edit target and geometric registration guide. Preserve its image dimensions, four quadrant layout, leaf positions, leaf outlines, short petioles, natural tears, internal holes and transparency. Do not redraw, translate, rotate, scale, add or remove any leaf or vein.
Convert leaf surface relief into a blue-violet tangent-space normal map: neutral outward surface approximately RGB (128,128,255), X encoded in red, upward Y encoded in green, positive Z encoded in blue. Use restrained smooth relief for the central midrib, secondary veins and gently folded blade planes. Violet/blue base with subtle cyan and pink directional deviations only; no albedo greens, browns, black ink, white painted veins, shading, ambient occlusion, specular light, cast shadows or height-map grayscale.
Every dark ink stroke in the albedo must not automatically become a deep carved trench. Veins should read as shallow raised relief; leaves remain thin with broad calm surface areas. The normal texture must share the exact visible silhouette and holes with Image 1, with generous unchanged transparent gutters. Outside the leaves and through the holes, preserve actual transparent alpha; hidden background RGB should be neutral (128,128,255).
Constraints: output ONLY the normal map corresponding to Image 1, no comparison board, no color panels, no text, no labels, no grid, no borders, no watermark. Preserve the supplied transparent alpha.
